raw: {"analysis":"MRX provides a more complete and actionable plan that addresses all repository facts: the two-person approval gate is explicitly triggered at the right time, CI costs are managed by squashing commits, the 4-hour staging lag is acknowledged with a cache purge request, and the sitemap flake has a pre-prepared manual retry script. WKP also covers these constraints reasonably well but has a critical sequencing error—it describes reviewers approving before the merge request is finalized, yet also says merge happens immediately after staging verification, creating ambiguity about when the two-person approval actually occurs. MRX's explicit gate ordering and rollback reasoning (read-only DB as natural fallback) make it more reliable for execution.","verdict":"MRX"}
